subject.title: refactor(sessions): canonical lineage model — creation provenance, fork ancestry, generation chain, typed row contract

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally make existing `sessions.patch` lineage fields invalid immediately, or should this refactor retain a compatibility/deprecation or versioned protocol path first?
rationale: The branch changes a public Gateway and generated-client contract rather than merely correcting an internal implementation; only maintainers can choose the supported upgrade policy.

options.title: Version or deprecate the contract
options.body: Retain a documented compatibility path or introduce a versioned replacement while trusted creation paths become canonical.

options.title: Approve the immediate break
options.body: Accept immediate `INVALID_REQUEST` responses for legacy lineage patch calls and document the breaking upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land rollover preservation separately and defer the public lineage-model contract change for dedicated API discussion.

recommendation.title: Version or deprecate the contract
recommendation.body: Retain a documented compatibility path or introduce a versioned replacement while trusted creation paths become canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the cohesive proposed model and can supply the technical compatibility options, while final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
